ite
        bcs failed
        lda path,u
        swi2
        fcb IClose
        bcs failed
        leax okmsg,pcr
        ldy #okmsgln
        lda #1
        swi2
        fcb IWrite
* --- error path: open a file that is not there ---
        leax missing,pcr
        lda #READ
        swi2
        fcb IOpen
        bcc unexpec
        pshs b
        leax experr,pcr
        ldy #experrl
        lda #1
        swi2
        fcb IWrite
        puls b
        swi2
        fcb FPErr
        clrb
        swi2
        fcb FExit
unexpec leax unexmsg,pcr
        ldy #unexln
        lda #1
        swi2
        fcb IWrite
        ldb #1
        swi2
        fcb FExit
failed  pshs b
        leax failmsg,pcr
        ldy #failln
        lda #1
        swi2
        fcb IWrite
        puls b
        swi2
